Build is clean now — exit code 0, "0 errors". The remaining 8 lines are genuine noise (Node deprecation warnings like `DEP0142`/`fs.exists`, `DEP0198`/`Buffer()`, etc., and a couple of unrelated lint-style warnings), not tied to the bump-induced bugs.

The real problem was two sequential regressions from the bundler bump (fakepack 3.11.2 → 4.2.0), both in the link stage:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the new bundler passes retry options as `{ retryCount }`, but `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries` (undefined), throwing on `.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but `isBackoffEnabled` only accepted strict `true`/`false` and threw otherwise. Simplified to `flags.backoffEnabled === true`, which treats anything else (including `undefined`) as disabled.
